desc: Introducing the top-performing M&P pistol trigger: the Tyrant CNC-made Smith & Wesson M&P trigger for both 1.0 and 2.0 generation guns. Whether you're handling a full-size or compact model, this M&P 1.0/2.0 trigger is designed to improve the firearm's functionality and efficiency. A shorter take-up and crisp break make this trigger a must-have upgrade for all M&P handgun enthusiasts. Compatible with 9mm, 10mm, and .45 caliber models.
